name: Beach Slap
detailed_description:
It's time to relax for a vacation, and you finally found your perfect spot. Alas, you're not alone...

There is only one beach and you are a disgruntled, selfish penguin. Dash, stomp and slap your way to vacation supremacy in this chaotic multiplayer brawl.

Control the terrain by changing it to your color. Dash your way across the map, jump and stomp the ground to fling your opponents, or give them the ol' flipper to the head to send them packing to the nearest pit.

Play from 2 to 4 players in local multiplayer, or up to 8 players online (with rollback!) accompanied by a colorful low-poly style and sweet bumpy tunes by Dale North.

Duke it out on hundreds of maps with different gimmicks and items, or create your own with the level editor and play them with your friends locally or online.

Important Note: This is a multiplayer only game! No single player is included

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 or above
  • Processor: 2 GHz Dual Core
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia® 8800 GT / AMD® 4670 or faster
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04, Ubuntu 24.04
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+, Vulkan capable GPUs
  • Additional Notes: Gnome desktop environment running on top of X11 or Wayland windowing system. Other configuration and user environment as provided stock with the supported distribution (such as Kernel or Compositor) Nvidia and AMD GPUs using Nvidia official proprietary graphics driver, or AMD Mesa graphics driver. Notes: • Ubuntu 22.04: Wayland is supported with AMD graphics cards. • Ubuntu 24.04: Wayland is supported with AMD graphics cards and Nvidia graphics cards utilizing Nvidia proprietary graphics drivers 550 and above.
